chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 356 – Xin Ruyin’s Bargain: Annihilate the Fu Clan for Knowledge
chapter_meta_description: Qi Yunxiao is dead. Xin Ruyin offers Han Li her husband’s notes and her formation lore—in exchange for a promise to wipe out an entire immortal clan.
og_description: Qi Yunxiao is dead. Xin Ruyin offers Han Li her husband’s notes and her formation lore—in exchange for a promise to wipe out an entire immortal clan.
twitter_title: RMJI 356 – A Promise Written in Blood
twitter_description: Qi Yunxiao is dead. Xin Ruyin gives away everything she owns—including the key to the ancient teleportation array—for one thing: the annihilation of the Fu Clan.

lore_anchors.definition: A wooden spirit tablet inscribed with the name of a deceased person, placed on an altar for ancestral worship and offering incense.
A woman who remains unmarried after her husband’s death, often considered a virtuous act in traditional Chinese culture; Xin Ruyin’s voluntary choice here carries deep emotional and social weight.
The third major cultivation realm in the RMJI system; a cultivator at this level possesses immense power and lifespan, and can exert crushing force over lower-realm opponents.
Qi Yunxiao’s personal cultivation journal and artifact refinement notes; a valuable legacy passed to Han Li.
A pre-arranged pattern of energy nodes and obstacles that can trap, kill, or confuse enemies; Qi Yunxiao managed to temporarily detain a Core Formation expert with an illusion formation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Xin Ruyin choose to become a widow after Qi Yunxiao died?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She felt she owed him several life-saving debts and intended to marry him eventually; becoming his widow was a way to fulfill that debt even in death.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Could Han Li actually fulfill her request to destroy the Fu Clan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is currently at Foundation Establishment. Reaching Core Formation is uncertain, and wiping out a clan the size of the Fu Clan—which has its own Core Formation experts—is a monumental task, making this a very long-term gamble.
